description: This file defines the HTMLPurifier_EntityLookup class, which provides functionality for entity name to character lookup using a serialized data file. It includes methods to set up the lookup table and to retrieve a singleton instance.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_EntityLookup
classes.description: Class providing entity lookup table for HTMLPurifier by loading serialized entity data, with singleton instance management.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the entity lookup table from a serialized file. Defaults to a specific file path if none is provided.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of HTMLPurifier_EntityLookup, optionally overwriting it with a provided prototype.
